title: About | Studio Birthplace
description: In the face of climate meltdown, massive inequity and a sixth mass extinction, we are committed to disrupt the way environmental and social stories are told.

overrideReasons.variant: as on the live site (phase 1): About's mission hero

content.title:
We craft campaigns to awaken hearts
and ignite change towards
**a just, healthy world.**

content.text: We're reclaiming **storytelling as a force for positive action and transformation.**
content.body: We’re in a Planetary Crisis, the stories we've been told are used for profit, fueling fear and disconnection. But a single film can spark change, rewrite the narrative, and drive culture. Together with changemakers, innovators and mission-driven brands, we don’t just tell stories - we inspire action. By changing the story, we change the system.

tabs.label: Campaign & Strategy
tabs.text: With years of experience, we’ve mastered strategic storytelling on urgent, sensitive topics. Our in-house team of writers, creatives, and marketers turns ideas into powerful campaigns that captivate and reach the widest audience possible.

tabs.label: Concept & Creative
tabs.text: Our studio is built on the belief that bold, original concepts are everything. We specialize in crafting ideas that captivate, inspire change, and push creative boundaries - no matter the challenge.

tabs.label: Production
tabs.text: We do it all - live-action, 3D animation, and everything in between. From sulfur mines to jungles and the ocean, we thrive in any environment. With over a decade of experience on Hollywood blockbusters, we bring top-tier visual effects that deliver unmatched impact for your budget.
